steps.text: Login to the mobile application, Land on accounts dashboard (account landed in the debit account number) and click ' CliQ '

All request histories will be available with different statuses. 
 a. Pending requests showing sender name / amount with accept / reject option. 
i. Accept: transfer amount will be debited from customer account  
 ii. Reject: customer needs to select ejected reason from a list 
  iii. Customer has two options for selecting beneficiary.
